title: Brute Force Detection
description: Alert when >10 failed_login events from single source.ip within 5 minutes. MITRE: T1110. Query filter: event.action=failed_login grouped by source.ip.

title: Credential Stuffing Detection
description: Alert when failed_login events occur across >5 distinct IPs with low attempt counts per IP across multiple user accounts. MITRE: T1110.004.

title: Port Scan / Service Discovery Detection
description: Alert when single source.ip connects to >10 distinct destination.port or sweeps endpoints within 10 minutes. MITRE: T1046.

title: SQL Injection (SQLi) Detection
description: Alert on url.original or request body matching SQLi patterns (UNION SELECT, OR 1=1, DROP TABLE). MITRE: T1190.

title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Detection
description: Alert on <script>, javascript:, onerror=, alert() in request URLs or parameters. MITRE: T1059.007.

title: Suspicious PowerShell Command Detection
description: Alert on powershell.exe invocations with -enc, -nop, -w hidden, or WebClient DownloadString flags. MITRE: T1059.001.

title: Command Injection Detection
description: Alert on shell delimiters (; | ` &) followed by whoami, id, cat /etc/passwd in web requests. MITRE: T1059.004.

title: Suspicious Authentication / Valid Accounts
description: Alert on successful login from anomalous external IP addresses or off-hours access. MITRE: T1078.

title: Impossible Travel Detection
description: Alert on logins for the same username from geographically distant source locations within short elapsed time. MITRE: T1078.004.

title: Account Takeover (ATO) Detection
description: Alert on successful login followed immediately by password/email changes or privilege escalation attempts. MITRE: T1078.001.

title: Privilege Escalation Detection
description: Alert on unauthorized sudo commands, SeDebugPrivilege token assignments, or root execution by standard users. MITRE: T1068.

title: Data Exfiltration Detection
description: Alert on abnormal high-volume outbound bytes (>500MB) or excessive DNS query payload lengths. MITRE: T1048.

title: Network Denial of Service (DDoS) Detection
description: Alert when request rate from an IP or subnet exceeds 500 requests per minute resulting in 502/504 errors. MITRE: T1498.

title: Lateral Movement Detection
description: Alert on internal host-to-host SMB (445), WinRM (5985), or SSH connections from unauthorized subnets. MITRE: T1021.002.

title: Phishing Click & Delivery Detection
description: Alert on outbound HTTP requests to newly registered phishing domains or suspicious email attachments. MITRE: T1566.

title: Active Reconnaissance / Perimeter Probing
description: Alert on scanner user-agents (nikto, sqlmap, nmap, dirbuster) or access to /.env, /wp-admin, /backup.sql. MITRE: T1595.

title: Persistence via Scheduled Task / Cron Detection
description: Alert on schtasks /create or modifications to /etc/cron.* by non-administrator user accounts. MITRE: T1053.

title: Malware Activity / C2 Beaconing Detection
description: Alert on regular interval outbound beaconing or execution of known malicious process hashes. MITRE: T1204.002.

title: Ransomware / Mass File Encryption Detection
description: Alert on rapid file renaming to .locked/.enc and execution of vssadmin delete shadows. MITRE: T1486.

title: Kerberoasting Detection
description: Alert on excessive Kerberos TGS requests with RC4 encryption targeting service principal accounts. MITRE: T1558.003.

title: Path Traversal Detection
description: Alert on ../, %2e%2e%2f, or /etc/passwd in URL path parameters. MITRE: T1083.

title: Insider Threat / Anomalous Data Access Detection
description: Alert on employee mass downloading confidential documents during off-hours or after notice period. MITRE: T1458.
